title: Informal Office
abstract:
Informal Research is a tool provided by Informal Office, designed to explore the topic of collaboration in graphic design and analyze various existing models, such as publishing houses and exhibition spaces, that can be implemented in contemporary graphic design.
Informal Office is a graphic design studio specializing in book design, brand identity, web design, and exhibition design. The studio is a collaborative project founded by three graphic designers, offering art direction and consultancy services. The core values of the collective include comparison, experimentation, and collaboration with other entities.

Informal Office is my MA graduation project, created in collaboration with Elisea Russo and Annalisa Marchetti. We designed the corporate identity, website, Informal Research book, and a video for the Capsule collection, showcasing the studio’s merchandise.
